entities.summary: Kavita Goyat is a female boxer from India. She competes in 69–75 kg weight category. Kavita won the bronze medal at the 2010 Asian Games held in Guangzhou, China. She lost 1:3 to Jinzi Li of China in the semi-finals of the Asian Games in 2010. Kavita Goyat was a athletes & competitors from Haryana (b. 1988-08-15, Haryana). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
